purpose: X01: LTRA run whose live history depth exceeds the native capacity bound 8192 (ltra_native), driven by a curved waveform so the overflow cannot be hidden by straight-line compaction.

oracle.derivation: Matched near-lossless line, Z0=sqrt(l/c)=50, Rs=RL=Z0 so GammaS=GammaL=0 and v(b)(t)=v(a)(t-Td) exactly. Source SIN(0 1 250meg): v(a)=0.5 sin(2 pi f t), v(b)=0.5 sin(2 pi f (t-Td)) for t>Td and 0 before. f=250 MHz makes Td=10 ns exactly 2.5 periods, so v(b)=-v(a) after the wavefront and a discarded still-live history entry cannot even produce the right SIGN. The forced 1 ps step makes the far-end value depend on an entry 10000 accepted points back, 1808 past the bound. compactrel=compactabs=1e-30 makes straightLineCheck reject every interior triple of this curved waveform, so compact() falls through to discarding the oldest interior point; the deck also fails at the default 1e-3/1e-12 (max v(b) error 0.917 V).
oracle.cross_check: Independent ngspice-44.2 run of this exact netlist agrees with the seven hand rows to 1.4e-7; the host is wrong by up to 0.919 V. See the .sp header for the tmax=10 ps control run.
